# Pacemate

> Pacemate is a free dating and community app for athletes and active singles (18+). It matches people by shared sports, fitness level, training routine and city, and helps them meet at local group sessions such as runs, rides, climbs, yoga and surf.

## Key facts

- Free to join; 18+ only; works in the browser on phone and desktop.
- Matching: members choose sports, level, usual training time, city and what they are looking for (a relationship, something casual, a training partner or friends). A mutual like creates a match and opens a private chat.
- Community events: weekly group sessions in cities across Europe, the Americas, Africa, Asia and Oceania.
- Daily features: workout logging, wellbeing check-ins, streaks and weekly goals, monthly challenges with city leaderboards, a question of the day, and kudos between matches.
- Safety: only matches can message, members can block and report, and first meetings are encouraged at public group sessions.
